description: This source file defines the SessionActorQueue class which manages an asynchronous queue for session actors, utilizing the KeyedAsyncQueue from the openclaw SDK. It provides methods for enqueueing operations, tracking pending counts per session, and testing the tail of the queue.

classes.name: SessionActorQueue
classes.description: Manages a queue of asynchronous operations per session (identified by actorKey), including methods for enqueueing tasks and retrieving queue and pending operation statistics.

methods.name: getTailMapForTesting
methods.description: Returns a map of the tail promises for each session's queue, used for testing purposes.

methods.name: getTotalPendingCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of pending operations across all sessions.

methods.name: getPendingCountForSession
methods.description: Returns the number of pending operations for a specific session identified by actorKey.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Enqueues an asynchronous operation for a given actorKey and manages the pending count for that session.
